sections.text_helper: Section 6.5.5 "Write protection" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 159.
sections.section_content:
The purpose of FLASH write protection is to prevent unwanted modifications to embedded
nonvolatile code and/or data.
A write-protected group of pages can neither be erased nor programmed. As a result, a
bank erase cannot be performed if some page is write-protected, unless a RDP level
transition to L0 is triggered (erasing the whole user flash memory).
Note: Write protection errors are documented in Section6.8.
